verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party docs say a scheduling link can connect to a Stripe product and require payment before the meeting time is reserved, so clients pay as they book. The docs also cover sales tax via Stripe Tax, any Stripe payment method, coupon codes, and managing offerings and prices natively. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the payment-at-booking flow; all evidence is vendor marketing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions

citations.quote: Connect your link to a corresponding product in your Stripe account and require payment before reserving the meeting time.
Clients pay as they book, and the meeting only lands on your calendar once the payment goes through.
Connect your Stripe account to collect payments on your scheduling links.
